User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user in the iPOS system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user entity.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was last updated.

definition.description: Stores user profile information. Uses path-based ownership for user data security.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier for the user.

firestore.reasoning: This design prioritizes simplicity and security for the iPOS application. We use path-based ownership for user data and avoid hierarchical authorization dependencies by storing all data directly under the user's document, ensuring authorization independence. This structure enables secure `list` operations. This approach streamlines security rule creation and enhances maintainability.
